precacheLuaVideoSprite.description: Loads a tagged video sprite ahead of time so it can start faster later.

parameters.tag: Unique video identifier. Later calls use the same tag.
parameters.path: Video asset path resolved by the engine helper.
parameters.volumeOrFront: Volume when numeric; compatibility front flag when boolean.
parameters.front: Places the video above gameplay layers when true.

playLuaVideoSprite.description: Creates or reuses a tagged video sprite and starts playback.

parameters.tag: Video identifier to create or reuse.
parameters.path: Optional video path. If omitted, the cached/preloaded tag is reused.
parameters.front: Draws in front of gameplay when true.

pauseLuaVideo.description: Pauses the active video assigned to the tag.

removeLuaVideo.description: Requests safe removal of the tagged video sprite.

forceRemoveLuaVideo.description: Removes the tagged video immediately, bypassing the delayed guard.

luaVideoExists.description: Returns whether the tagged video exists.

isLuaVideoPlaying.description: Returns whether the tagged video is currently playing.

setLuaVideoVolume.description: Sets the volume of a tagged video.

getLuaVideoVolume.description: Returns the current volume of the tagged video.

getLuaVideoTime.description: Returns current playback time in seconds.
